summary: Iteration 3 full-stack verification of (a) migration of all imagery to locally hosted /images/*.jpg, (b) the three-text devotional module (Hanuman Chalisa 43 / Aditya Hridayam 10 / Vishnu Sahasranama 8) with five-language meanings and per-verse TTS, (c) the ElevenLabs->OpenAI voice-provider fallback with honest UI disclosure, plus regression of gating-OFF free access, auth playbook items and all core flows. Backend: 112 pytest tests passed (31 new in test_texts.py, 76 existing backend_test.py+test_chalisa.py, 5 gating-switch with -n 0) — 0 failures. Frontend: every tested flow passed with zero console errors. No blocking or high-priority defects found.

minor.issue: Login/preflight responses come back with 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' together with 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true' (verified with Origin: https://evil.example.com). backend/.env sets an explicit CORS_ORIGINS, so the wildcard appears to be injected by the preview ingress and overrides/duplicates the FastAPI header. Browsers reject credentialed cross-origin requests when ACAO is '*', so cookie-based auth would fail from any other origin; the app itself is unaffected because it sends the Bearer token from localStorage. Worth confirming the deployed (non-preview) config sends the explicit origin.

issues: 'TOTAL SCORE' stays 0 after three Reaction Time rounds (only Number Memory contributes points). Reads as a bug to users even if intentional — consider labelling it 'Memory score' or excluding reaction rounds from the tile.

action_items: Optional: confirm production CORS returns the explicit origin (not '*') alongside allow-credentials.
Optional: clarify/relabel the 'Total score' tile on the games dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1053 lines and now carries the TEXTS registry, TTS provider abstraction and every pillar endpoint; consider splitting texts/TTS into its own router module to stay under the ~700-line guideline.

synthesize()/voice_for() read ELEVENLABS_API_KEY on every request, so a key added later takes effect without restart — good; note that existing cached mp3 keys already embed the provider so no stale-audio risk.
TTS cache files in AUDIO_CACHE grow unbounded (one mp3 per verse x language x provider); an eviction or size cap would be prudent.

rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — no defect reproduced this iteration. The reported English accent on Indic recitation remains present by design because the OpenAI TTS fallback path is active (no ElevenLabs key); the code correctly selects eleven_multilingual_v2 whenever ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is set, sends Devanagari rather than transliteration for recitation, and the UI discloses the limitation, which is what was asked for.
